name: webvideo
description: Turn scripts, articles, lessons, product demos, and talks into click-driven web presentations that can be screen-recorded as cinematic videos. v1.7 adds three orientations: landscape 16:9 (1920×1080) / portrait 9:16 (1080×1920) / square 1:1 (1080×1080) — chapter projects are single-orientation (locked at scaffold time via --orientation), covers use a single codebase with 5 ratio modifier classes (16x9 / 4x3 / 9x16 / 3x4 / 1x1) selected automatically per project. v1.8 adds TTS-safe narration text rules (disambiguate polyphonic characters into full words, expand abbreviations to their spoken form, convert unit symbols to spoken Chinese units) enforced across SCRIPT-STYLE / CHAPTER-CRAFT / AUDIO so synthesized voiceover doesn't mispronounce. Ships a Vite + React + TypeScript scaffold, a (chapter, step) cursor model, hard collaboration checkpoints, a theme-token architecture, a programmatic Playwright + ffmpeg rendering pipeline (mp4 at the project's orientation, no post-crop), and a Phase 5 distribution pack (5-variant cover AB-test pack + ≤250-char description.md + HH:MM:SS chapters.md for platform timeline markers).
